name: How long does pool removal take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How many days does a typical pool removal job take in the Los Angeles area, including inspections?
mainEntity.text: How many days does a typical pool removal job take in the Los Angeles area, including inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple pool removal can move quickly once permits are ready and the site is accessible. Many projects take only a few working days for demolition, debris hauling, backfill, and rough grading. However, the full timeline is often longer because of permit approval, inspection scheduling, utility checks, and possible compaction testing. Partial removals usually finish faster than full removals because less excavation and disposal is needed. Complex projects in Los Angeles neighborhoods may take more time if crews must protect landscaping, navigate tight access, or coordinate city inspections. A homeowner should ask for both the active work time and the total calendar time. The active demolition may be short, but the overall project can stretch if the city needs revisions or if weather delays compaction. If the yard will later be landscaped or rebuilt, add time for finish grading and surface restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most pool removal projects take about 3 to 7 working days, but inspections, permit processing, and weather can add time. A straightforward partial removal may finish faster, while a full removal with hauling, grading, and compaction testing can take longer.
